description: Mixed-source technical atlas: 36 poses retaken on 2026-11-13 at 9824fd56 (Dâmbovița level and banks; stale tiles refreshed); all other images retain their recorded sources and dates.
coverageNote: Every 250 m grid cell intersecting the runtime playable mask or exact analytic 600 m ring is included. This describes capture coverage only; it is not a fidelity score. Boundary cells also contain land outside the ring.
reviewNote: Sign-affected current game captures inspected at full size; source/aerial comparisons retain their historical scope. No district fidelity acceptance.

review.status: Complete retained earlier review coverage plus 1 fresh exact-pose structural/separator pairs inspected; genuine source-height, materials, context and imagery-date limits remain.
review.comparisonMethod: Private georeferenced Esri crop at each exact250m north-up ground square; actual source/image/sheet hashes retained per frame. Roof parallax and unknown reference acquisition are not source measurements. Reference imagery is not published.
remainingGaps: Current0775 canal retakes: restrained shoreline and dark model-blue water versus green reference. Broad source masses remain, with simplified sawtooth roofs, parking occupancy and sparse outer commercial context.

Current0775 canal/industrial corridor: source roads and water remain visible. Cooling towers are simple cylinders, industrial roof detail and canopy are approximate; bridge structural fidelity is not established by this top-down review.

Current0775 campus/pond squares: restrained shore band, blue model ponds versus green/brown reference. Lawn/canopy coverage, roof forms and actual parking differ; detailed real-world parity remains incomplete.
Current0775 southern pond/boundary square retains source water but sparse outer detail and canopy differences remain visible.
Cathedral surroundings and outside/distant context remain sparse or generic; contextual source detail is incomplete.
Industrial sawtooth roofs, cooling-tower structure, campus roofs and railway detail remain simplified where dimensions/detail lack source support.
Canopy appearance and actual parking occupancy differ from the unknown-date reference; source bodies and measured crowns remain retained.
